notes.title: Devlog 02/01/25 - New year, similar goals, and, more updates about them!
The demo is live, people!
notes.notes:
We have now, as we speak, posted the demo for you to play, and are so excited to see what you think about it! Please, let us know all your thoughts, and feedback.

It's a first sneak peak at the game, what we have now and a good view of what will come. Basically, if you like the vibe here, but would like a longer more interactive version in a good few months, you should definitely wishlist it cause that is very much what we are planning to give you! 


So please, try the demo, and tell us everything about what you experienced, if there was any bugs, and of course, if you had fun :)

Cheerio,

///Buck

notes.title: Devlog 10/11/24 - We've possibly lied but it's okay because we fixed it!
notes.notes:
Hi there, everyone!

We did sound more certain than we possibly had the right to be that the demo was done and coming oh, so soon in our last devlog, [i]HOWEVER[/i], not to worry, cause now the demo is done! We will be posting it on the 15th, and you will be able to play it, and we will be so happy to hear your thoughts <3 

Other than that one piece of news we don't have much to tell you, but the one piece of news is big, so we feel no shame about it. 

Talk to you in a few days, when we'll be able to finally show you the game, or some of it, and hear your thoughts, or some of them, on it!

Ciao, 

//Buck

notes.title: Devlog 8/9/24 - It continues.
notes.notes:
Hi gang!

Updates since last devlog: We’ve gotten further along with the work on the new demo, and as we speak, at this time, it is basically, basically done and ready to be uploaded for all of you lovely people to try out! As it stands we’ve had a few hiccups that have delayed us posting it a little longer than intended, but unless we have some real bad luck it will be uploaded in a short little while. We look forwards, anxiously, to showing you what we have so far and we look forwards, with excitement, to hearing what you have to say.

Other than that we’ve made a first little short video to promote the game, that has been uploaded to our social medias. There will be more of that coming soon, and if you’d like to be updated on this and also talk with us in the comments, you should check it out and follow us! We’re on Instagram, Tiktok and Youtube. The workload of having one person making the entire game and the other one kind of checking Youtube sometimes can feel a bit uneven, and you can help us with this by asking some real convoluted, complicated questions in the comments for me to answer. It would really help us out. 

With that I wanna say goodbye for this week, I’ll be back with a little update next week as well, hopefully sometime more in the middle of the week rather than Sunday evening.

Ciao!

//Buck

notes.title: Devlog 30/8/24 - It begins.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

With a little more than a year left until the official release of Dissecting Love, we’ve decided it’s time to start being a little bit more communicative with you about the progress. This is why we’ve decided we’ll from now on write a shorter weekly devlog, to tell you what’s been going on and  what we’ve been up to. 

This week, our programming, graphics, and music team (the one guy making this game) has been at Gamescom in Cologne, helping out a friend with their project, which means he’s not been able to do much in the ways of programming, graphics, and music. However, this following week is very packed as we’re planning to have the demo done on the 1st of September, which means he has a lot of bug fixing and general poking around ahead of him. 

Our marketing team, me, got started this week as well. I’ll be the one posting a devlog here every week. I’ll also be making some videos and posts for social media, and in general making sure people find out more about this game. Maybe chatting with you in the comments of videos, possibly in the future on Discord as well if we decide to set up a server. 

That’s the summary of this week! Hope you’ll have a lovely week and see you next Monday when I’ll be posting a new one of these.

//Buck
